recommendation: Keep the commit as-is; it completes the intended rename for the remaining current build source surface found by targeted search, with no separate related issue decision needed.
issue_request: FHIR-3559 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core DSTU1 change request to rename the reference type notation from Resource(...) to Reference(...) throughout the specification and reference implementations to avoid confusion with the base Resource class/resource type.
initial_application: Jira records application on 29-Sept-2014 as svn revision 2922. The imported git-svn commit c2ef24dd533bcd9d1960834f5b5ce54f8e1eab89, titled "Rename Resource() / ResourceReference to reference() / Reference", performed the broad original rename.
additional_context: The current references page already uses Reference(...) examples. Targeted current-source search still found a small bounded set of stale legacy type-name references in active resource/example source and the mapping tutorial. Lower-case RelatedArtifact.resourceReference is a current element name and was intentionally left unchanged.
reconciliation: Updated stale current-source comments/examples to Reference(Any), Reference(TLeft2), Reference(TRight2), and Reference.display in Communication, Encounter, mapping tutorial, Practitioner, and Procedure source.
source_changes: source/communication/communication-example-fm-attachment.xml: changed a comment from Resource(Any) to Reference(Any).
source/encounter/encounter-example-f201-20130404.xml: changed a TODO comment from Resource (any) to Reference(Any).
source/mapping-tutorial.html: changed tutorial pseudo-structure references from Resource(TLeft2/TRight2) to Reference(TLeft2/TRight2).
source/practitioner/structuredefinition-Practitioner.xml: changed Practitioner.name commentary from ResourceReference.display to Reference.display.
source/procedure/procedure-example-f201-tpf.xml: changed a TODO comment from Resource (any) to Reference(Any).

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core issue requesting that reference type notation be renamed from Resource(...) to Reference(...), with application recorded for DSTU1.
evidence_items.learned: This is the final WG intent and defines the expected current terminology.

evidence_items.summary: Imported git-svn commit titled 'Rename Resource() / ResourceReference to reference() / Reference' corresponds to svn revision 2922.
evidence_items.learned: The issue was historically applied broadly, so current Resource(...)/ResourceReference type-name remnants are cleanup misses rather than a new policy decision.

evidence_items.summary: Current reference guidance uses Reference(Observation|DiagnosticReport) and Reference(Any).
evidence_items.learned: The authoritative current page already reflects the Reference(...) name.
